message.content: {"decision":"reject","reason":"This article presents a high-level maturity model for production-grade LLM systems focusing on engineering practices like determinism, evaluation, and observability, but it does not provide concrete, learner-relevant guidance or evidence about what coding tasks beginners can safely delegate to agents or how to check agent output.
